title: Cauchy–Schwarz for Fourth Moments
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a measure space, and let $A,D\in L^4(\mu)$ be real-valued functions. Then $\left(\int A^2D^2\,d\mu\right)^2\leq\left(\int A^4\,d\mu\right)\left(\int D^4\,d\mu\right)$.
replaced: Let $A,D\in L^4(\mu)$ be real functions on an arbitrary measure space. Then $(\int A^2D^2\,d\mu)^2\le(\int A^4\,d\mu)(\int D^4\,d\mu)$.
